newsitem.title: EGYPT: Egyptian shares mixed in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Egyptian shares mixed in quiet trade.

text.p: Egyptian share prices were mixed in very quiet trading on Sunday as investors preferred to keep shares until prices go up, brokers said.
The Capital Market Authority (CMA) all-share index closed 0.03 points lower at 234.84 after shares worth 20.95 million pounds ($6.16 million) changed hands.

"The volume was below average," said Ahmed el-Helw, vice president of brokers Hermes Financial. "Prices are still very cheap and there are a lot of investors who want to buy but no one is interested in selling."
Recently privatised Kafr el-Zayat Pesticides and Chemicals rose 0.98 pounds to close at 44.99 pounds after shares worth 1.5 million pounds changed hands.
Blue-chip Amriyah Cement closed 0.50 pounds higher at 54.00 pounds after shares worth 911,476 pounds were traded.
Blue-chip Commercial International Bank (CIB) lost 1.40 pounds to finish at 474.00.
The CMA index for openly traded firms declined to 339.48 points from 340.62 on Thursday and the index for rarely traded "closed" firms steadied at 160.64.
Declining stocks outnumbered gainers 14 to 15 while another 25 firms were traded but ended unchanged.
